method: Board texts: corpus/decisions.json (20 decisions) plus the 12 recorded decisions from demo-state/step3/decisions-from-graph.json (their texts are not in decisions.json). For each question in corpus/questions.json (dev, held_out, legacy) and corpus/questions-model-authored.json (m1-m16): read the question, checked which of the 32 decision texts (title+content+rationale) answers it, ran a substring check of each answer_keywords set across all 32 texts, and for unanswerable questions grepped every absent_term case-insensitively across all 32 texts and app/**/*.py|*.sql (none found). Overlap: judged by eye against docs/QUESTIONS.md; I recounted m6 by hand (5/8 = 0.62, matches). I did not re-run scripts/question_overlap.py. exactly_one_right_decision values: yes, yes_with_caveat (a second decision partly answers or a keyword matches several), no_two_decisions_answer, none_correct (unanswerable and confirmed). DRAFT. Reviewer is a different model from the evidence authors (reference list: an assistant model after the first recorded run; questions: an assistant model / claude-haiku-5-5) but the same vendor family, so shared blind spots are possible. A person must spot-check.
limits: DRAFT. Reviewer is a different model from the evidence authors (reference list: an assistant model after the first recorded run; questions: an assistant model / claude-haiku-5-5) but the same vendor family, so shared blind spots are possible. A person must spot-check.

verdicts.evidence: jwt-algorithm title 'signed with the HS256 algorithm'; the question only shares 'algorithm','tokens' (signing~signed). But token-expiry's text also says 'HS256 JWTs' (answer keyword HS256 is in both texts), so a retriever returning token-expiry also answers it.

article-ownership: 'Only an article's author ... may modify'; comment-ownership is about comments. Pure paraphrase (piece of writing=article, edit or remove=modify); zero shared words, agree with 0.0. Semantically easy though.
Title has 'Request validation failures return HTTP 422'; question reuses 'request','validation','API'. Only this text gives 422 (answer keyword unique).

article-slug-conflict says slug exists -> 400, no suffix. slug-rules text also says 'no extra suffix' and unique slug but not the outcome. 'URL name'=slug paraphrase, 0 shared words, agree. Keyword '400' also in duplicate-registration.
no-refresh-tokens: 'no refresh endpoint. A client ... logs in again'; question shares 'again'. token-expiry does not discuss renewal. Reason (SR-2025-14) only in this decision.
hard-delete-articles: 'removed from the database, with no soft-delete flag'; question reuses 'removed','deleted'. Unique.
reset-link-lifetime: 'Password reset links stay valid for 30 minutes' vs question 'link ... new password ... keep working'; shares link, long(-lived), password. Unique; 30 minutes only here.
reject-fancyhash: 'fancyhash package is not used for password hashing because of its licence'; question shares 'hashing','package'. Unique (ruled out ~ rejected).
tag-handling title names 'tags table' and 'articles_to_tags'. tag-create-idempotent does not name tables. Unique.

favorites-no-notification: 'sends no notification to its author' with PD-8 reason; question 'author hear about it ... likes' is paraphrase; shares article, author. Unique (favorites decision does not mention notifications).
absent_terms region, cloud: not in any of the 32 decision texts nor any app/*.py|*.sql (checked case-insensitively). Database url is a setting (settings/app.py:21), no hosting info.
per minute / rate limit / throttl: absent from decisions and app code.
on call / pager: absent from decisions and app code.
jwt-subject-claim: 'fixed subject claim access'; question shares 'constant'. token-expiry text also says 'subject "access"' (answer keyword 'access' is in 4 decision texts), so ambiguous by keyword.

password-salt: 'random salt created with bcrypt.gensalt'; question shares 'random','each'. password-hashing text also describes per-user salt from bcrypt.gensalt (answer keyword gensalt in both), so two decisions answer it.

duplicate-registration: 'username or email already taken ... HTTP 400'; question shares 'already'. 'name' = username. Answer '400' appears also in article-slug-conflict but the question is about sign-up.
cors-allowed-origins: 'allowed from the origins in allowed_hosts, which default to every origin'; question shares 'origins'. Unique. Note allowed_hosts is overridden by env in real deployments.

connection-pool-size: 'pool is fixed at 10 connections'; question shares 'database','connections'. Unique among decisions, but code says test settings use 5 (settings/test.py:16-17), so '10' is the default only. Answer keyword '10' is a weak substring (also in 3 other decision texts).

tag-create-idempotent: 'already exists is ignored ... saving an article with a known tag'; shares 'already','saving'. tag-handling text ('first creates any tags that do not exist') partly answers too.
bcrypt-work-factor: 'keeps the default passlib work factor' with LT-9 reason; question 'cost of password hashing not raised' is paraphrase; shares 'password'. Reason only here.
page-size-default-reason: 'defaults to 20 items per page' + DR-31. pagination-parameters also states default 20 but gives no reason; question asks why, so one right decision.
postgres-over-mongodb: 'MongoDB was not chosen'; question says 'document-oriented database' (needs world knowledge), shares 'team'. Reason ADR-3 only here.

tokens-header-only: 'never in cookies' + CSRF reason; question 'browser-stored session identifiers' = cookies, 0 shared words, agree. no-refresh-tokens mentions 'stolen browser profile' but is not about transport.

aiosql-over-orm: 'hand-written SQL files, not generated by an ORM' + ADR-4; question 'library produce our SQL automatically' paraphrase; shares 'sql'. Note: code itself uses pypika for the article filter query (repositories/articles.py:115), so title 'Queries are hand-written SQL files' is not fully true of app/.
welcome / smtp / mail provider absent from decisions and app code. No email sending exists.
megabyte / upload absent; User model has only `image: Optional[str]` (users.py:12), a URL, no upload route.
payment / subscription / billing absent from decisions and code. (profile follow is called 'subscribe' only in strings.py: UNABLE_TO_UNSUBSCRIBE_FROM_YOURSELF; not payment.)
no-refresh-tokens: 'no refresh tokens' + stolen-token reason; question shares sessions/team/token. Unique; 0.38/0.5 matches my count.
hard-delete-articles rationale 'Legal review LR-77 ... gone from live storage'; question shares deleted, storage ('compliance'=legal).
Question copies 'fancyhash', 'password hashing' from the decision title; 'licensing objection' ~ 'licence'. Agree 0.43/0.57; fancyhash name makes it near-lexical.
Question reuses 'bcrypt' and 'default' from the title 'bcrypt keeps the default passlib work factor'. Unique.
Question reuses 'API','tokens','cookies' of 'Tokens travel only in Authorization header and never in cookies'. Unique.

Question 'stored user row keep each user's random salt' is almost the decision's own sentence ('Each user gets a random salt', 'The user row stores the salt next to the hashed password'); I recounted 5 of 8 content words shared = 0.62, agree. password-hashing text mentions per-user salt but not the user row storage.

validation-error-shape: 'Request validation failures return HTTP 422 with an errors list'; question reuses request, validation. error-response-shape (errors list for HTTP errors) is a near-duplicate, but the question is about validation.

token-expiry says 'expire one week after issue', but no-refresh-tokens also says 'single access token that is valid for one week' (answer keyword 'week' in both; QUESTIONS.md counts 2 decisions sharing more words). Question words 'access token valid' reuse no-refresh-tokens wording directly. The 'one right decision' is not unique.
Question reuses 'already exists', 'tags table', 'article', 'tag' from tag-create-idempotent; tag-handling (title says 'tags table', content creates only missing tags) also answers partly.

Question 'library loads the SQL query files ... driver' near-copies 'raw SQL files loaded by aiosql on the asyncpg driver' (0.71, agree). answer_keywords has only asyncpg (the driver); library half (aiosql) not checked. 'asyncpg' is also in test-layout text.
Question copies 'PostgreSQL', 'articles, tags and favorites' from the decision content (0.75 agree). Near-lexical.

Question reuses 'queries ... written by hand ... generated ... ORM' from title 'hand-written SQL files, not generated by an ORM'; reason is DBA review. Agree 0.6/0.7. 'DBA' keyword also in postgres-over-mongodb text.
rate limiting / throttling absent from decisions and code (checked). Login code only compares credentials (routes/authentication.py:29).
WebSocket / real-time absent.
avatar upload / profile photo absent; only image URL string field.
GraphQL absent from decisions and code.
Only auth-header-scheme gives the prefix rule (split on space, jwt_token_prefix, default 'Token'); tokens-header-only covers transport only. Shares 'prefix','token'.
token-expiry ('expire one week') and no-refresh-tokens ('valid for one week') both answer. 0 exact shared words (login vs access), agree with table; paraphrase.
password-hashing (bcrypt via passlib) answers; reject-fancyhash content 'Password hashing stays on passlib with bcrypt' also does; shares passwords/user/app.
error-response-shape '{"errors": [detail]}'. validation-error-shape also gives a failure body (errors list) and 'a request fails' could mean validation. Table 0.0 exact agree.
pagination-parameters names limit and offset; page-size-default-reason only the default 20. Shares articles, parameters, query.
slug-rules: slugify(title). article-slug-conflict content also says slug built from title (but names no library). Shares 'article'.
comment-ownership: 'Only the comment's author ... may delete a comment'; question reuses comment, delete (0.67). hard-delete-articles mentions deleting comments but not who may.
favorites: insert row ignoring duplicates. favorites-no-notification ('Adding a favorite writes a database row and nothing else') also partly answers. Shares article, user.
settings-loading: BaseSettings chosen by APP_ENV, lru_cache. cors / pool decisions mention single settings, not loading. Shares app, settings.
test-layout: tests folder split into test_api, test_db... Unique. Shares 'tests'.
